issues.question: Does an ordinary mixed diet limit glutathione synthesis in the way the experimental amino-acid formula did?
issues.established: In seven healthy young men, ten days of an amino-acid formula with methionine and cysteine both removed slowed whole-blood glutathione synthesis. The glutathione concentration stayed about the same.
issues.claim_boundary: This does not show that everyday meals are short of methionine and cysteine, or that eating more of either amino acid would raise glutathione synthesis.
issues.resolution_needs: A human study that measures glutathione synthesis while people eat ordinary mixed diets, rather than an amino-acid formula with both sulfur amino acids removed.

issues.question: Does the same change in sulfur-amino-acid intake affect glutathione synthesis in the brain?
issues.established: The human measurements are of whole-blood or red-cell glutathione synthesis. In the formula study, the synthesis rate changed while the blood concentration did not.
issues.claim_boundary: Blood-cell results do not show that these diets change glutathione synthesis in nerve tissue.
issues.resolution_needs: A measurement of glutathione synthesis in nerve tissue under the same dietary conditions.

issues.question: Does N-acetylcysteine or glycine change glutathione synthesis when either is given on its own?
issues.established: In older adults, N-acetylcysteine given together with glycine raised erythrocyte glutathione synthesis.
issues.claim_boundary: That result does not show an effect of either supplement alone, and it does not provide a dose for ordinary food.
issues.resolution_needs: A human synthesis study that changes one of these precursors at a time, including the milligram dose used in the combined protocol.

issues.question: Does removing methionine alone slow glutathione synthesis when cysteine intake stays adequate?
issues.established: Synthesis slowed when methionine and cysteine were removed together. It did not slow in young men when cysteine was removed and methionine intake stayed adequate.
issues.claim_boundary: The combined result does not show that methionine by itself is the limit, and the cysteine-free result does not show what happens when methionine is the amino acid removed.
issues.resolution_needs: A human synthesis study that removes methionine while cysteine intake remains adequate.

issues.question: Do these changes in glutathione synthesis improve recovery, stress resilience, or ADHD?
issues.established: Blood-cell glutathione synthesis can change under the dietary and supplement conditions already studied. Those studies did not measure recovery, stress resilience, or ADHD.
issues.claim_boundary: A change in blood-cell synthesis does not show that foods or supplements treat recovery, stress, or ADHD.
issues.resolution_needs: A study that measures recovery, stress resilience, or ADHD, rather than only blood-cell glutathione synthesis or oxidative-stress markers.

issues.question: Does a myrosinase-active whole broccoli sprout supplement raise phase II enzyme RNA the way the sprout homogenate did?
issues.established: Houghton calculates that about 2 grams of a 1% sulforaphane-yielding powder might match the sulforaphane in Riedl’s 200 gram homogenate. That calculation is not a trial of the powder. Myrosinase-inactive supplements produced lower plasma isothiocyanate metabolites than fresh sprouts in the comparison Houghton cites.
issues.claim_boundary: A supplement is not admitted. The homogenate result does not transfer to a capsule or powder.
issues.resolution_needs: A human study of a defined myrosinase-active whole broccoli sprout supplement that measures phase II enzyme RNA or Nrf2 target-gene expression.

issues.question: Does the 2019 zinc and selenium chapter show that either mineral constrains the Nrf2 activation step?
issues.established: Verlaet places zinc on copper-zinc superoxide dismutase and selenium on glutathione peroxidase. Those are downstream antioxidant enzymes. The chapter itself was not retrieved in full.
issues.claim_boundary: Zinc and selenium are not admitted as requirements of Nrf2 activation.
issues.resolution_needs: A reading of Mocchegiani and Malavolta 2019 that separates enzyme cofactor roles from the Nrf2 activation step.

issues.question: Which green-Mediterranean food components independently change visceral fat or adipose inflammatory signalling?
issues.established: The combined pattern reduced visceral fat; both Mediterranean groups received walnuts.
issues.claim_boundary: The trial does not identify separate causal effects of walnuts, tea, Mankai or meat substitution.
issues.resolution_needs: Component or factorial comparisons with defined substitutions, fat imaging and adipose endpoints.

issues.question: Does urinary urolithin A indicate a causal food-to-adipose pathway?
issues.established: Urolithin A was an associated urine marker in DIRECT-PLUS. A separate pomegranate-vinegar trial reported a preliminary CT visceral-fat signal.
issues.claim_boundary: Association does not establish mediation, a walnut-specific source, pomegranate efficacy or a supplement effect. The formulation result cannot be generalized to ordinary pomegranate fruit.
issues.resolution_needs: A separate food/formulation-specific intervention with metabolite and adipose target-engagement measures.

issues.question: Does dietary magnesium availability constrain human adipose stress regulation?
issues.established: The review identifies plausible biology; primary mouse effects vary with context.
issues.claim_boundary: No human PM8 dietary requirement or extra-intake benefit is inferred; a smaller fat depot is not necessarily healthier tissue.
issues.resolution_needs: Recover a defined adipose dependency and dietary-supply chain or a human tissue intervention, retaining null and adverse results.

issues.question: Do the measured dietary and tissue effects improve brain-related function through adipose signalling?
issues.established: Dietary, biopsy and imaging studies establish selected adipose or systemic endpoints.
issues.claim_boundary: Whole-body resource allocation, cognitive benefit and adipose mediation were not established in this assessment.
issues.resolution_needs: Direct functional endpoints with an adequately tested adipose-mediated path.

issues.question: Does time restriction alter adipose inflammation independently of weight loss and subgroup selection?
issues.established: TREAD found exploratory pathway changes in seven greatest weight losers versus six matched controls; another trial was null for extra VAT loss.
issues.claim_boundary: No individual transcript passed FDR and independent timing-specific tissue benefit remains unresolved.
issues.resolution_needs: Prespecified adequately sized biopsy analysis, weight-loss-matched comparison and independent replication.

issues.question: Does the retained mitochondrial cofactor-pool mapping establish a distinct PM-specific supply or constraint relationship?
issues.established: The historical mapping is retained as unresolved context; no constituent is inherited.
issues.claim_boundary: KC membership and biochemical participation do not automatically establish dietary supply or limitation.
issues.resolution_needs: Independently reconcile pool applicability and any individually supported supply chain without duplicating admitted dietary inputs.

issues.question: Which dietary interventions alter source-specific mitochondrial ROS generation while preserving physiological signalling?
issues.established: Human feeding/activity studies measured net H2O2 emission; source-selective tool compounds support experimental source discrimination.
issues.claim_boundary: Emission is not gross production; lower ROS is not intrinsically better; no dietary-to-brain/ADHD effect established.
issues.resolution_needs: Source-resolved intervention studies with scavenging, respiratory state, tissue and clinical context addressed.

issues.question: When does dietary precursor or compound supply sustain the specified local mitochondrial protective function?
issues.established: Vitamin E and manganese have bounded Capacity relationships; ubiquinol particle chemistry and mitochondrial GSH import have distinct evidence.
issues.claim_boundary: Endogenous synthesis, precursor supply, cellular GSH, plasma conjugates and local protective activity are not interchangeable.
issues.resolution_needs: Resolve reduced-form identities/conversion and context-dependent delivery; retain the NAC transport counterexample and sulforaphane exposure limitations.

issues.question: Do the preserved historical Phenome and therapeutic-area explanations support their stated mitochondrial claims?
issues.established: Verlaet measured erythrocyte GSH and peripheral biomarkers, not mitochondrial lactate metabolism or local mitochondrial protection. Historical ratings and relationship records are preserved, not revalidated.
issues.claim_boundary: The legacy mitochondrial lactate/GSH assertion is not established by the cited peripheral ADHD study.
issues.resolution_needs: Review the exact inherited relationship propositions and source labels; preserve provenance and do not promote them into new dietary or causal claims.
